prompts: Inside a bright civic training room of a Lebanese government ministry in Beirut: tall windows with pale limestone arched frames typical of Beirut public buildings, cream plaster walls, wooden tables arranged in a U-shape. Seven Lebanese professionals of mixed ages (civil servants, a schoolteacher, a nurse in pale blue scrubs, a small-business owner; some women wearing headscarves and some not, men in shirts and knitwear) sit at the tables working on open silver laptops during a generative-AI certification session; a Lebanese woman trainer in a Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) blazer stands at the front of the room, gesturing as she explains. Over-the-shoulder view from behind two participants in the foreground, so that their laptop screens face the camera and are clearly visible; each laptop screen is a chroma-key green rectangle. On the far wall hangs one large framed certificate whose entire paper area is a chroma-key green rectangle, and next to it a rectangular wall sign panel that is a chroma-key green rectangle. Seated eye-level camera, gentle depth of field, focus on the two foreground participants typing. A government primary school classroom in a small Indian town: pale green and cream painted walls, ceiling fans, a blackboard with simple chalk drawings of shapes (no writing), wooden benches and desks, afternoon sun through barred windows. At the centre, on the teacher's wooden table, stands one all-in-one AI desktop PC facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle: a slim matte Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) chassis with a broad flat bottom bezel; a small chroma-key green rectangle is centred on that bottom bezel (about one fifth of the screen width, where a badge would be), and the monitor screen itself is a chroma-key green rectangle. An Indian woman teacher in a simple cotton sari leans in and points at the screen while five schoolchildren aged 9 to 11 in light blue and white government school uniforms gather around; two children sit at the keyboard, the others watch attentively. Camera slightly behind and beside the children at their eye level, so the screen and its bezel face the camera. Kenyan farmland in the central highlands in warm late-afternoon light: rows of young maize, red-earth tracks, scattered acacia trees, soft white clouds. In the middle distance on the right stands one sovereign data-centre node: a single 40-foot shipping-container data centre painted matte Gulf Blue (#1E3A5F) on a low concrete plinth, with a white steel door and ventilation louvres, sheltered by a raised steel canopy of solar panels; on the long side of the container facing the camera is a large flat chroma-key green rectangular panel. Behind it, clearly visible, are a small rural health clinic (single-storey white building with a veranda) and a primary school (single-storey building with a corrugated roof and a small playground). In the foreground on the left a Kenyan woman smallholder farmer in a headwrap and practical work clothes stands among the maize, holding a smartphone at chest height and listening to it on speaker; the phone screen is tilted toward the camera and is a chroma-key green rectangle. Standing eye-level camera; the farmer in sharp focus on the left third.
